region.name: Port Huron / Blue Water Area
region.framing: A qualitative regional setting for small-business ideas, not a claim about any particular business or current local condition.

cues: Make routine information and follow-up easy to handle when schedules and travel can be less predictable.
Favor useful digital access that complements normal in-person service.
Help teams refresh recurring information and prepare for a busier mix of inquiries.
Keep changes light enough to fit alongside everyday work.
Make mobile-friendly information and quick handoffs easier during active days.
Support changing demand without asserting tourism, event, or weather conditions.
Help teams organize follow-up and reusable information as routines shift toward year-end.
Preserve familiar service while reducing avoidable administrative repetition.

capability_bundles.name: Inquiry handoff
capabilities: a focused inquiry form or lightweight internal tool
drafting and sorting assistance with human review
a connection to the team's existing inbox or customer system

capability_bundles.name: Repeatable information flow
capabilities: a structured workflow for updating and reusing approved business information
simple reporting from information the business already collects

capability_bundles.name: Operations bridge
capabilities: a small integration between existing tools
practical improvements to forms, notifications, or internal digital steps

capability_bundles.name: Service guide
capabilities: a focused online guide or interactive helper
an accessible path to the business's existing contact or service process

situations.description: A small team repeatedly explains the same service details before it can route an inquiry.

preservation.tools: Keep the current inbox, phone, and customer tools in place.
preservation.decision_authority: The owner or team still decides how every inquiry is answered and routed.
preservation.untouched_steps: Keep the existing conversation and service steps that already work.

situations.description: Approved business information is useful in several places but takes repeated effort to keep consistent.

preservation.tools: Keep the current website, documents, and publishing tools unless the owner chooses otherwise.
preservation.decision_authority: The business approves source material and every public update.
preservation.untouched_steps: Leave specialized advice and customer conversations with the people who handle them now.

situations.description: A routine handoff between tools requires retyping or checking the same information.

preservation.tools: Retain the systems the team already relies on.
preservation.decision_authority: People remain responsible for exceptions, approvals, and final actions.
preservation.untouched_steps: Do not automate judgment-heavy or relationship-based work.

situations.description: People can find the business online but the useful next step could be clearer and easier to complete.

preservation.tools: Build around the current site and contact channels.
preservation.decision_authority: The owner chooses the offered next step and controls its wording.
preservation.untouched_steps: Keep the existing personal follow-up after someone reaches out.

prohibited_claim_classes: reviews, cookies, sessions, or inferred visitor behavior
off-site research or unsupported local assertions
weather forecasts, events, or changing business facts
numeric outcomes, pricing, or return-on-investment claims
